 -14, 0, 12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 20) })
        end
        return h
    end
    local function card(parent, order, height)
        local c = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = parent,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, height or 0),
            AutomaticSize = height and Enum.AutomaticSize.None or Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = order,
            ZIndex = Z + 2,
        })
        c:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        corner(c, 14)
        stroke(c, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.65)
        return c
    end
    local function pad(obj, t, l, r, b)
        mk("UIPadding", { Parent = obj, PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, t), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, l), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, r), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, b) })
    end
    local function list(obj, padding, horizontal)
        return mk("UIListLayout", {
            Parent = obj,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, padding),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            FillDirection = horizontal and Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
            VerticalAlignment = horizontal and Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
        })
    end
    -- chips (segmentado): opts = { {key, es, en}, ... }
    local function chips(parent, opts, order, onPick, height)
        local row = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
            Parent = parent,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 28),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            ScrollBarThickness = 0,
            LayoutOrder = order,
            ZIndex = Z + 3,
        })
        list(row, 6, true)
        local items = {}
        local api = {}
        function api.Set(key)
            for k, it in pairs(items) do
                local on = k == key
                it.BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.Background
                it.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.3
                it.TextColor3 = on and Theme.AccentText or Theme.Text
                it:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", on and "Accent" or "Background")
                it:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", on and "AccentText" or "Text")
            end
            api.Value = key
        end
        for i, o in ipairs(opts) do
            local b = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = row,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, (height or 28) - 2),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                TextSize = 11,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                LayoutOrder = i,
                ZIndex = Z + 4,
            })
            b:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            L(b, o[2], o[3])
            corner(b, 999)
            pad(b, 0, 11, 11, 0)
            local sc = mk("UIScale", { Parent = b, Scale = 1 })
            b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.07), { Scale = 0.9 }):Play() end)
            b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play() end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() sc.Scale = 1 end)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.35)
                api.Set(o[1])
                onPick(o[1])
            end)
            items[o[1]] = b
        end
        api.Row = row
        api.Items = items
        return api
    end
    local function fmtNum(v, step)
        if step >= 1 then return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5)) end
        if step >= 0.1 then return string.format("%.1f", v) end
        return string.format("%.2f", v)
    end
    local function toHex(c)
        return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
    end
    local function fromHex(s)
        s = tostring(s or ""):gsub("#", ""):gsub("%s", "")
        if not s:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return nil end
        return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(s:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(s:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(s:sub(5, 6), 16))
    end

    -- ---------- motor de capas (misma matemática que ApplyLogoIcon) ----------
    local function buildLayers(btn, layers, zBase)
        local out = {}
        for i, def in ipairs(layers) do
            local sc = def.Scale or 1.6
            local off = -((sc - 1) / 2)
            local lbl = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = btn,
                Size = UDim2.new(sc, 0, sc, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(off, 0, off, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = def.Image or "",
                ImageColor3 = def.Color or WHITE,
                ImageTransparency = def.Transparency or 0,
                ZIndex = zBase + i,
            })
            mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", { AspectRatio = 1 }, lbl)
            out[i] = { label = lbl, def = def, state = { angle = 0, speed = def.Speed or 60, time = 0 } }
        end
        return out
    end
    local function stepLayers(entries, dt)
        for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
            local lbl, def, st = entry.label, entry.def, entry.state
            if lbl.Parent then
                local mv = def.Movement or "None"
                local spd = def.Speed or 60
                local amt = def.Amount or 0
                local dir = def.Direction or 1
                local sc = def.Scale or 1.6
                local off = -((sc - 1) / 2)
                st.time = st.time + dt
                if mv == "Spin" then
                    if (def.Style or "Constant") == "Organic" then
                        local target = spd + math.sin(st.time * 0.8) * (spd * 0.33)
                        st.speed = st.speed + (target - st.speed) * 0.08
                    else
                        st.speed = spd
                    end
                    st.angle = st.angle + st.speed * dir * dt
                    lbl.Rotation = st.angle
                elseif mv == "Pulse" then
                    local scale = 1 + math.sin(st.time * (2 * math.pi / spd)) * ((amt ~= 0 and amt or 12) / 100)
                    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(sc * scale, 0, sc * scale, 0)
                    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(off * scale, 0, off * scale, 0)
                elseif mv == "Orbit" then
                    local radius = amt ~= 0 and amt or 6
                    local angle = st.time * math.rad(spd) * dir
                    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(off, math.cos(angle) * radius, off, math.sin(angle) * radius)
                elseif mv == "Float" then
                    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(off, 0, off, math.sin(st.time * (2 * math.pi / spd)) * (amt ~= 0 and amt or 4))
                elseif mv == "Shake" then
                    local intensity = amt ~= 0 and amt or 2
                    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(off, math.sin(st.time * spd * math.pi * 2 + 0.3) * intensity, off, math.cos(st.time * spd * math.pi * 2) * intensity)
                elseif mv == "Fade" then
                    local maxAlpha = math.clamp(amt ~= 0 and amt or 0.6, 0, 1)
                    lbl.ImageTransparency = ((math.sin(st.time * (2 * math.pi / spd)) + 1) / 2) * maxAlpha
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Botón base: círculo del color del tema (o el elegido) + borde 1.5, igual que ToggleButton
    local function paintButtonBase(btn, btnStroke, icon)
        if icon.NoBackground then
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            btnStroke.Transparency = 1
        else
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = icon.BgColor or Theme.Accent
            btnStroke.Transparency = 0
            btnStroke.Color = icon.BorderColor or Theme.Accent
        end
    end
    -- Miniatura fija (tarjetas y cabecera): botón + todas las capas, sin animar
    local function composite(parent, icon, px, z)
        local holder = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = parent,
            Name = "LogoComposite",
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px, px),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = z,
        })
        -- el botón se achica si alguna capa es grande, así todo entra en la miniatura
        local maxScale = 1
        for _, lay in ipairs(icon.Layers or {}) do
            maxScale = math.max(maxScale, tonumber(lay.Scale) or 1.6)
        end
        local frac = math.clamp(0.98 / maxScale, 0.3, 0.62)
        local btn = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(frac, frac),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = z,
        })
        corner(btn, 999)
        local st = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = btn, Thickness = 1.5 })
        paintButtonBase(btn, st, icon)
        buildLayers(btn, icon.Layers or {}, z)
        return holder
    end
    LP.composite = composite

    -- ---------- estado del editor ----------
    local ED = { rec = nil, editingId = nil }
    local function blankLayer(img)
        return { Image = img or "", Movement = "None", Speed = 60, Amount = 0, Direction = 1, Style = "Organic", Scale = 1.6, Transparency = 0, Color = nil }
    end
    local function blankRec()
        return {
            Name = "",
            NoBackground = false,
            BgColor = nil,
            BorderColor = nil,
            Layers = { blankLayer("rbxassetid://106130066496682") },
            ClickSound = { Id = "", Volume = 0.6 },
            IdleSound = { Id = "", Interval = 15, Volume = 0.15 },
        }
    end
    -- catálogo/guardado -> estado editable (colores Color3, sonidos siempre presentes)
    local function recFromIcon(icon, name)
        local r = blankRec()
        r.Name = name or ""
        r.NoBackground = icon.NoBackground == true
        r.BgColor = typeof(icon.BgColor) == "Color3" and icon.BgColor or (type(icon.BgColor) == "table" and arrayToColor(icon.BgColor, nil)) or nil
        r.BorderColor = typeof(icon.BorderColor) == "Color3" and icon.BorderColor or (type(icon.BorderColor) == "table" and arrayToColor(icon.BorderColor, nil)) or nil
        r.Layers = {}
        for i, src in ipairs(icon.Layers or {}) do
            if i > 3 then break end
            if type(src.Image) == "string" and src.Image ~= "" then
                local lay = blankLayer(src.Image)
                lay.Movement = CL.Moves[src.Movement] and src.Movement or "None"
                lay.Speed = tonumber(src.Speed) or (MOVE_INFO[lay.Movement].speed and MOVE_INFO[lay.Movement].speed[4]) or 60
                lay.Amount = tonumber(src.Amount) or 0
                lay.Direction = src.Direction == -1 and -1 or 1
                lay.Style = src.Style == "Constant" and "Constant" or "Organic"
                lay.Scale = tonumber(src.Scale) or 1.6
                lay.Transparency = tonumber(src.Transparency) or 0
                lay.Color = typeof(src.Color) == "Color3" and src.Color or (type(src.Color) == "table" and arrayToColor(src.Color, nil)) or nil
                table.insert(r.Layers, lay)
            end
        end
        if #r.Layers == 0 then r.Layers = { blankLayer("") } end
        if type(icon.ClickSound) == "table" and type(icon.ClickSound.Id) == "string" then
            r.ClickSound = { Id = icon.ClickSound.Id, Volume = tonumber(icon.ClickSound.Volume) or 0.6 }
        end
        if type(icon.IdleSound) == "table" and type(icon.IdleSound.Id) == "string" then
            r.IdleSound = { Id = icon.IdleSound.Id, Interval = tonumber(icon.IdleSound.Interval) or 15, Volume = tonumber(icon.IdleSound.Volume) or 0.15 }
        end
        return r
    end
    -- estado editable -> registro para guardar (pasa por CL.Sanitize)
    local function recToSaved(r, id)
        local s = {
            Id = id,
            Name = r.Name,
            NoBackground = r.NoBackground,
            BgColor = r.BgColor and colorToArray(r.BgColor) or nil,
            BorderColor = r.BorderColor and colorToArray(r.BorderColor) or nil,
            Created = os.time(),
            Layers = {},
            ClickSound = r.ClickSound,
            IdleSound = r.IdleSound,
        }
        for i, lay in ipairs(r.Layers) do
            local c = table.clone(lay)
            c.Color = lay.Color and colorToArray(lay.Color) or nil
            s.Layers[i] = c
        end
        return CL.Sanitize(s)
    end
    -- capas que se pueden dibujar ya (las que tienen imagen)
    local function drawableIcon(r)
        local icon = { NoBackground = r.NoBackground, BgColor = r.BgColor, BorderColor = r.BorderColor, Layers = {} }
        for _, lay in ipairs(r.Layers) do
            local img = CL.CleanAsset(lay.Image)
            if img ~= "" then
                local c = table.clone(lay)
                c.Image = img
                table.insert(icon.Layers, c)
            end
        end
        return icon
    end

    local statusToken = 0
    local function setStatus(es, en, color)
        statusToken += 1
        Status:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", es)
        Status:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)
        Status.Text = GetText(es, en)
        Status.TextColor3 = color or Theme.TextDim
        local my = statusToken
        task.delay(5, function()
            if statusToken == my and Status.Text == GetText(es, en) then
                L(Status, "", "")
            end
        end)
    end

    local PreviewCard = card(Content, 1)

    local Stage = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = PreviewCard,
        Name = "Stage",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 214),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 28),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,

    local SZ = Z + 4 -- capas del escenario: SZ..SZ+14 · botón: SZ+30.. · ventana: SZ+20

    local function sframe(parent, props)
        props.Parent = parent
        props.BorderSizePixel = 0
        props.ZIndex = props.ZIndex or SZ
        return mk("Frame", props)
    end
    local function round(f) corner(f, 999) return f end
    local function vgrad(f, top, bottom)
        mk("UIGradient", { Parent = f, Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(top, bottom) })
    end

    local Scenes = {}
    -- Día: cielo, sol con halo, nubes que se mueven, montañas, pasto, perspectiva y un personaje
    function Scenes.day()
        local s = sframe(Stage, { Name = "SceneDay", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE })
        vgrad(s, Color3.fromRGB(78, 150, 232), Color3.fromRGB(176, 220, 252))
        round(sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.2), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 200), BackgroundTransparency = 0.75, ZIndex = SZ + 1 }))
        round(sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.2), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 160), ZIndex = SZ + 2 }))
        for i, c in ipairs({ { 0.18, 0.16, 1 }, { 0.55, 0.1, 0.8 }, { 0.38, 0.3, 0.65 } }) do
            local cloud = sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70 * c[3], 24 * c[3]), Position = UDim2.fromScale(c[1], c[2]), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = SZ + 2 })
            round(sframe(cloud, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.7), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.3), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.08, ZIndex = SZ + 3 }))
            round(sframe(cloud, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.08, ZIndex = SZ + 3 }))
            round(sframe(cloud, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.55, 0.62), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.45, 0.38), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.08, ZIndex = SZ + 3 }))
            TweenService:Create(cloud, TweenInfo.new(14 + i * 5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { Position = UDim2.fromScale(c[1] + 0.12, c[2]) }):Play()
        end
        for _, m in ipairs({ { 0.12, 120, Color3.fromRGB(96, 128, 170) }, { 0.42, 150, Color3.fromRGB(84, 116, 160) }, { 0.78, 130, Color3.fromRGB(104, 138, 178) } }) do
            sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(m[2], m[2]), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(m[1], 0, 0.62, m[2] * 0.2), Rotation = 45, BackgroundColor3 = m[3], ZIndex = SZ + 4 })
        end
        local ground = sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.4), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.6), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = SZ + 5 })
        vgrad(ground, Color3.fromRGB(112, 186, 104), Color3.fromRGB(58, 118, 62))
        for i = 1, 4 do
            local y = (i / 5) ^ 1.6
            sframe(ground, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, y), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 70, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 0.7, ZIndex = SZ + 6 })
        end
        for _, a in ipairs({ -62, -40, 40, 62 }) do
            sframe(ground, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1.6, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), Rotation = a, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 70, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 0.75, ZIndex = SZ + 6 })
        end
        -- personaje de bloques (genérico) con sombra
        local char = sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 40), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.55, 0.84), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = SZ + 7 })
        round(sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 6), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.55, 0.845), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.7, ZIndex = SZ + 6 }))
        corner(sframe(char, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 48), ZIndex = SZ + 9 }), 3)
        sframe(char, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 11), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 200), ZIndex = SZ + 8 })
        sframe(char, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 13), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 11), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 48), ZIndex = SZ + 8 })
        sframe(char, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 13), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 11), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 48), ZIndex = SZ + 8 })
        sframe(char, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 15), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 25), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 80, 95), ZIndex = SZ + 8 })
        sframe(char, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 15), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 25), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 80, 95), ZIndex = SZ + 8 })
        TweenService:Create(char, TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { Position = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0.84, -2) }):Play()
        return s
    end
    -- Noche: degradado azul, luna, estrellas que titilan, colinas oscuras
    function Scenes.night()
        local s = sframe(Stage, { Name = "SceneNight", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE })
        vgrad(s, Color3.fromRGB(8
, 10, 32), Color3.fromRGB(48, 36, 92))
        for i = 1, 22 do
            local x, y = ((i * 37) % 97) / 100, ((i * 53) % 55) / 100
            local star = round(sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(i % 3 == 0 and 3 or 2, i % 3 == 0 and 3 or 2), Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, ZIndex = SZ + 1 }))
            TweenService:Create(star, TweenInfo.new(0.8 + (i % 5) * 0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.85 }):Play()
        end
        round(sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.22), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 210, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 0.85, ZIndex = SZ + 2 }))
        round(sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.22), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 238, 255), ZIndex = SZ + 3 }))
        round(sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.8, 9, 0.22, -5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 44), ZIndex = SZ + 4 }))
        for _, m in ipairs({ { 0.2, 160 }, { 0.62, 190 }, { 0.95, 150 } }) do
            round(sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(m[2] * 1.6, m[2]), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(m[1], 0.66), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 40), ZIndex = SZ + 5 }))
        end
        return s
    end
    -- Claro: fondo de app claro (para ver contraste en pantallas blancas)
    function Scenes.light()
        local s = sframe(Stage, { Name = "SceneLight", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE })
        vgrad(s, Color3.fromRGB(246, 247, 251), Color3.fromRGB(222, 226, 236))
        for i = 1, 3 do
            corner(sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0.3 + i * 0.13, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 222), ZIndex = SZ + 1 }), 7)
        end
        return s
    end
    -- Transparente: tablero de ajedrez para ver los bordes reales de cada imagen
    function Scenes.checker()
        local s = sframe(Stage, { Name = "SceneChecker", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 210) })
        -- solo los cuadros claros (el fondo ya es el gris): 12 filas x 24 columnas de 18 px
        for r = 0, 11 do
            for c = 0, 23 do
                if (r + c) % 2 == 0 then
                    sframe(s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(c * 18, r * 18), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 248), ZIndex = SZ + 1 })
                end
            end
        end
        return s
    end
    local SceneFrames = {}
    local HUD -- controles de celular (se ocultan en "Transparente")
    local function setBackdrop(key)
        LS.backdrop = key
        if not SceneFrames[key] then
            SceneFrames[key] = Scenes[key]()
        end
        for k, f in pairs(SceneFrames) do
            f.Visible = k == key
        end
        if HUD then HUD.Visible = key ~= "checker" end
        StageStroke.Color = key == "light" and Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 170) or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end

    -- HUD de celular encima del juego: barra superior, joystick y botón de saltar real de Roblox
    HUD = sframe(Stage, { Name = "MockHud", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = SZ + 12 })
    do
        local top = sframe(HUD, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22), BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, ZIndex = SZ + 12 })
        corner(top, 12)
        local menu = sframe(top, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = SZ + 13 })
        for i = 0, 2 do
            corner(sframe(menu, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 2), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 3 + i * 4), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = SZ + 14 }), 1)
        end
        local chat = round(sframe(top, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = SZ + 13 }))
        mk("UIStroke", { Parent = chat, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1.5 })
        sframe(top, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 15), Rotation = 45, BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = SZ + 13 })
        -- joystick
        local ring = round(sframe(HUD, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 58), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -12), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.75, ZIndex = SZ + 12 }))
        mk("UIStroke", { Parent = ring, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 2, Transparency = 0.45 })
        local knob = round(sframe(ring, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, ZIndex = SZ + 13 }))
        TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(2.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 7, 0.5, -4) }):Play()
        -- botón de saltar: misma textura y recorte que usa Roblox (TouchJump, sin presionar)
        mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = HUD,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -14),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Input/TouchControlsSheetV2.png",
            ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(1, 146),
            ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(144, 144),
            ZIndex = SZ + 12,
        })
    end

    -- Ventana "fantasma" de la librería: se abre/cierra al tocar el botón, como la real
    local Ghost = mk("CanvasGroup", {
        Parent = Stage,
        Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0.72, 0),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.55, 0.5),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        GroupTransparency = 1,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = SZ + 20,
    })
    Ghost:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
    corner(Ghost, 10)
    stroke(Ghost, Theme.Stroke, 1.2, 0.2)
    local GhostScale = mk("UIScale", { Parent = Ghost, Scale = 0.85 })
    do
        local bar = sframe(Ghost, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, ZIndex = SZ + 21 })
        bar:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        mk("TextLabel", { Parent = bar, Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Yin Yang", TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = SZ + 22 })
        for i = 0, 2 do
            round(sframe(bar, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6 - i * 9, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TextDim, ZIndex = SZ + 22 }))
        end
        local side = sframe(Ghost, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 1, -20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, ZIndex = SZ + 21 })
        for i = 0, 3 do
            corner(sframe(side, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 6 + i * 18), BackgroundColor3 = i == 0 and Theme.Accent or Theme.AccentOff, ZIndex = SZ + 22 }), 4)
        end
        for i = 0, 3 do
            local row = sframe(Ghost, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28 + i * 22), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, ZIndex = SZ + 21 })
            corner(row, 6)
            corner(sframe(row, { Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 4), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, -2), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TextDim, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, ZIndex = SZ + 22 }), 2)
            local sw = sframe(row, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 10), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = i % 2 == 0 and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff, ZIndex = SZ + 22 })
            corner(sw, 5)
        end
    end
    local ghostOpen = false
    local function setGhost(open)
        ghostOpen = open
        if open then Ghost.Visible = true end
        TweenService:Create(Ghost, TweenInfo.new(open and 0.28 or 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { GroupTransparency = open and 0 or 1 }):Play()
        local tw = TweenService:Create(GhostScale, TweenInfo.new(open and 0.32 or 0.18, open and Enum.EasingStyle.Back or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = open and 1 or 0.85 })
        tw:Play()
        if not open then
            tw.Completed:Connect(function()
                if not ghostOpen then Ghost.Visible = false end
            end)
        end
    end

    -- El botón flotante de la vista previa: mismo tamaño (42 px), círculo, borde y capas que el real
    local PvButton = mk("TextButton", {
        Parent = Stage,
        Name = "PreviewToggle",
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 52),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "",
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = SZ + 30,
    })
    corner(PvButton, 999)
    local PvStroke = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = PvButton, Color = Theme.Accent, Thickness = 1.5 })
    local PvPress = mk("UIScale", { Parent = PvButton, Scale = 1 })
    local function applyZoom()
        PvPress.Scale = LS.zoom
    end

    local Hint = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = Stage,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
        TextColor3 = WHITE,
        TextSize = 10,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        ZIndex = SZ + 40,
    })
    Hint:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
    L(Hint, "Tocalo o arrastralo, igual que el de verdad", "Tap or drag it, just like the real one")
    corner(Hint, 999)
    pad(Hint, 0, 10, 10, 0)

    -- movimiento real: arrastrar dentro del escenario y tocar para abrir/cerrar
    do
        local dragging, moved, startInput, startPos = false, false, nil, nil
        PvButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging, moved = true, false
                startInput, startPos = input.Position, PvButton.Position
                Content.ScrollingEnabled = false
                TweenService:Create(PvPress, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 0.88 * LS.zoom }):Play()
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local delta = input.Position - startInput
                if delta.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
                if moved then
                    local size = Stage.AbsoluteSize
                    local x = math.clamp(startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 4, math.max(4, size.X - 46))
                    local y = math.clamp(startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y, 4, math.max(4, size.Y - 46))
                    PvButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                end
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = false
                Content.ScrollingEnabled = true
                TweenService:Create(PvPress, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = LS.zoom }):Play()
                if Hint.Visible then
                    TweenService:Create(Hint, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
                    task.delay(0.3, function() Hint.Visible = false end)
                end
                if not moved then
                    local cs = ED.rec and ED.rec.ClickSound
                    local sid = cs and CL.CleanAsset(cs.Id) or ""
                    if not ghostOpen then
                        playSound(sid ~= "" and sid or Sounds.Click, sid ~= "" and (cs.Volume or 0.6) or 0.6)
                    end
                    setGhost(not ghostOpen)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- dibuja el logo del editor en el botón de la vista previa
    local function rebuildPreview()
        local old = LS.live
        for _, e in ipairs(old) do
            if e.label then e.label:Destroy() end
        end
        local icon = drawableIcon(ED.rec)
        paintButtonBase(PvButton, PvStroke, icon)
        LS.live = buildLayers(PvButton, icon.Layers, SZ + 30)
        -- se conserva el ángulo/tiempo de cada capa: mover un deslizador no reinicia la animación
        for i, e in ipairs(LS.live) do
            if old[i] then
                e.state = old[i].state
                if e.def.Movement == "Spin" then e.label.Rotation = e.state.angle end
            end
        end
    end

    -- barra de herramientas de la vista previa
    local Tools = mk("Frame", { Parent = PreviewCard, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
    local backdropChips = chips(Tools, {
        { "day", "Día", "Day" }, { "night", "Noche", "Night" }, { "light", "Claro", "Light" }, { "checker", "Transparente", "Transparent" },
    }, 1, setBackdrop)
    backdropChips.Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 1, 0)
    local zoomChips = chips(Tools, { { 1, "1x", "1x" }, { 2, "2x", "2x" }, { 3, "3x", "3x" } }, 2, function(z)
        LS.zoom = z
        applyZoom()
    end)
    zoomChips.Row.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(108, 28)
    zoomChips.Row.Position = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0, 0)

    -- interruptor: verlo también en el botón flotante REAL mientras editás
    local RealRow = mk("TextButton", { Parent = PreviewCard, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, Text = "", LayoutOrder = 3, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
    RealRow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
    corner(RealRow, 10)
    label(RealRow, "Ver en mi botón real", "Show on my real button", 12, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 5), ZIndex = Z + 4 })
    label(RealRow, "El botón flotante de verdad cambia mientras editás", "The actual floating button changes while you edit", 9, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "TextDim", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 22), ZIndex = Z + 4 })
    local RealTrack = mk("Frame", { Parent = RealRow, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 22), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
    corner(RealTrack, 999)
    local RealKnob = mk("Frame", { Parent = RealTrack, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
    corner(RealKnob, 999)
    local PREVIEW_KEY = "Custom:__preview"
    local realToken = 0
    local function pushReal()
        if not LS.realLive then return end
        realToken += 1
        local my = realToken
        task.delay(0.2, function() -- un solo redibujo por ráfaga de cambios
            if my ~= realToken or not LS.realLive then return end
            local icon = drawableIcon(ED.rec)
            if #icon.Layers == 0 then return end
            icon.LabelES, icon.LabelEN, icon.Custom = "Vista previa", "Preview", true
            local cs = ED.rec.ClickSound
            if cs and CL.CleanAsset(cs.Id) ~= "" then icon.ClickSound = { Id = CL.CleanAsset(cs.Id), Volume = cs.Volume } end
            IconCatalog.Icons[PREVIEW_KEY] = icon
            pcall(ApplyLogoIcon, PREVIEW_KEY)
        end)
    end
    local function setRealLive(on)
        LS.realLive = on
        TweenService:Create(RealKnob, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(on and 21 or 3, 3) }):Play()
        RealTrack.BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff
        if on then
            pushReal()
        else
            realToken += 1
            IconCatalog.Icons[PREVIEW_KEY] = nil
            pcall(ApplyLogoIcon, SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon or "ClassicYinYang")
        end
    end
    RealRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4)
        setRealLive(not LS.realLive)
    end)

    local function changed()
        rebuildPreview()
        pushReal()
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- 2) NOMBRE + PLANTILLAS

    sectionTitle(Content, "NOMBRE Y PUNTO DE PARTIDA", "NAME & STARTING POINT", 2, "Empezá de cero o copiá un logo del catálogo y modificalo", "Start from scratch or copy a catalog logo and tweak it")
    local NameCard = card(Content, 3)
    pad(NameCard, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    list(NameCard, 8)

    NameBox.PlaceholderText = GetText("Nombre de tu logo", "Your logo name")
    corner(NameBox, 10)

    NameBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        nameStroke.Color = Theme.Stroke
        nameStroke.Transparency = 0.6
        ED.rec.Name = NameBox.Text:sub(1, 24)
    end)

    local TemplateRow = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
        Parent = NameCard,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 74),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,

        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),

        LayoutOrder = 2,
        ZIndex = Z + 3,
    })
    list(TemplateRow, 8, true)

    local openEditor -- se define abajo
    local rebuildLayerCards, refreshBaseCard, refreshSoundCard -- idem

    local function loadRecIntoEditor(r, keepName)
        local name = keepName and ED.rec and ED.rec.Name or r.Name
        ED.rec = r
        ED.rec.Name = name or ""
        NameBox.Text = ED.rec.Name
        rebuildLayerCards()
        refreshBaseCard()
        refreshSoundCard()
        changed()
    end

    local function templateTile(order, es, en, iconForThumb, onPick)
        local t = mk("TextButton", { Parent = TemplateRow, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 72), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, Text = "", LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        t:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        corner(t, 12)
        stroke(t, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.7)
        local stage = mk("Frame", { Parent = t, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 6), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        if iconForThumb then
            composite(stage, iconForThumb, 44, Z + 5)
        else
            local plus = label(stage, "+", "+", 26, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Accent", {
